title: The inclusion of the Zariski site into the small etale site is a morphism of sites
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $X_{\rm Zar}$ its small Zariski site (objects the open subschemes $U\subseteq X$, morphisms the inclusions, coverings the jointly surjective families of open inclusions) [def-sc-zariski-site] and $X_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $u:X_{\rm Zar}\to X_{\Et}$ be the functor sending an open subscheme $U$ to the etale $X$-scheme $U\hookrightarrow X$ (an open immersion is etale) and an inclusion $W\subseteq U$ to the corresponding $X$-morphism. Then: (1) $u$ is continuous in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (3): a Zariski covering $\{U_i\subseteq U\}$ goes to an etale covering, and for $T\subseteq U$ the canonical morphism $u(T\cap U_i)\to u(T)\times_{u(U)}u(U_i)$ is an isomorphism; (2) $X_{\rm Zar}$ has the final object $X$ and fibre products $V\times_UW=V\cap W$, and $u$ carries $X$ to the final object $\mathrm{id}_X$ of $X_{\Et}$ and commutes with these fibre products; (3) consequently $u_s$ is exact on sheaves of sets, i.e. $u$ defines a morphism of sites $\epsilon:X_{\Et}\to X_{\rm Zar}$ with $\epsilon_*\mathcal F=\mathcal F\circ u$, $(\epsilon_*\mathcal F)(U)=\mathcal F(U\hookrightarrow X)$, and $\epsilon^{-1}=u_s$ its left adjoint.
